job_stats_descr: See what you've done out at sea
reading_voltage_normal: Voltage: 12.4 V, within the normal range.
reading_voltage_low: Voltage: 2.1 V, far below the expected 12 V.
reading_voltage_unstable: Voltage: jumps between 0 and 12 V, unstable.
reading_voltage_none: Voltage: 0.0 V, no power reaches the unit at all.
reading_lamp_ok: Lamp: lights up normally when powered directly.
reading_lamp_broken: Lamp: stays dark when powered directly, the filament is broken.
reading_pressure_normal: Pressure test: the housing holds pressure and is dry.
reading_pressure_low: Pressure test: the housing won't hold pressure, the seal is leaking.
reading_pressure_high: Pressure test: the housing holds pressure, but it's full of water.
reading_signal_normal: Signal: strong and stable link to shore.
reading_signal_weak: Signal: weak, with frequent packet loss.
reading_flow_normal: Flow: steady at the expected rate.
reading_flow_low: Flow: steady, but only at about a third of the expected rate.
reading_flow_none: Flow: nothing gets through, the line is blocked.
reading_tension_normal: Tension: steady, within the normal range for the chain.
reading_tension_low: Tension: far too low, the chain is barely holding the float.
reading_tension_high: Tension: far too high, something is pulling the float down.
reading_tension_erratic: Tension: jumps up and down with every wave, the connection has play in it.
reading_buoyancy_normal: Buoyancy: the float sits at its normal waterline.
reading_buoyancy_low: Buoyancy: the float sits well below its normal waterline.
reading_line_clear: Mooring line: clear, nothing caught on it.
reading_line_fouled: Mooring line: wrapped in old fishing net and kelp.
reading_vibration_normal: Vibration: smooth and steady, the pump runs normally.
reading_vibration_heavy: Vibration: heavy and irregular, something inside the pump is worn.
reading_vibration_none: Vibration: none at all, the pump is not running.
reading_hydraulics_normal: Hydraulics: oil pressure steady at the working level.
reading_hydraulics_low: Hydraulics: oil pressure keeps dropping, and the reservoir is low.
reading_hydraulics_none: Hydraulics: no oil pressure builds up at all, the reservoir is full.
reading_leak_streaming: Leak trace: a steady stream of fuel rises from inside the wreck.
reading_leak_seeping: Leak trace: small drops of oil escape every now and then.
reading_hull_intact: Hull scan: the hull is intact around the fuel tank.
reading_hull_cracked: Hull scan: a long crack runs through the hull over the fuel tank.
reading_hull_hatch_open: Hull scan: the hull is intact, but the cargo hatch is open and drums are visible inside.
symptom_failed_connect: The beacon flickers and then goes dark
symptom_dark_beacon: The beacon stays dark, even at night
symptom_led_blinking: The beacon is dark, but the controller's status LED keeps blinking
symptom_damaged_seal: There are damp patches inside the lantern housing and the buoy sits lower in the water
symptom_light_daytime: The beacon stays on in broad daylight, even after the controller restarted itself
symptom_signal_dropouts: The station keeps dropping its connection to shore for minutes at a time
symptom_station_offline: The station has gone completely silent, the shore team receives nothing
symptom_bad_data: The station is online, but its readings are erratic and make no sense
symptom_water_ingress: Shore reports a moisture alarm from inside the station housing
symptom_wrong_pattern: The beacon flashes in the wrong rhythm, and the controller shows an error code
symptom_fails_in_waves: The beacon only cuts out when waves wash over it, and works fine in calm weather
symptom_low_throughput: Shore reports the pipeline's throughput has dropped to almost nothing
symptom_valve_unresponsive: The valve no longer responds to commands from shore
symptom_buoy_drifted: The mooring float has drifted away from its marked position
symptom_buoy_rattling: The mooring float jerks and rattles with every wave
symptom_buoy_low: The mooring float sits noticeably low in the water
symptom_buoy_tilted: The mooring float sits low in the water and leans over to one side
symptom_pump_output_dropped: Shore reports the pump station's output has dropped steadily over the past weeks
symptom_pump_rough: Shore reports the pump station's output has dropped, and it runs louder than usual
symptom_pump_moisture: Shore reports a moisture alarm from the pump motor
symptom_pump_stopped: The pump station has stopped completely, shore gets no response
symptom_hpu_pressure_dropping: Shore sees the hydraulic pressure slowly dropping, and there is an oil sheen on the surface
symptom_hpu_valves_stuck: The subsea valves no longer move, although the hydraulic unit reports it's online
symptom_hpu_no_contact: Shore has lost all contact with the hydraulic unit
symptom_hpu_tripping: The hydraulic unit keeps tripping its breaker and sends garbled data
symptom_wreck_slick: A thick oil slick keeps spreading above the wreck
symptom_wreck_sheen: A thin rainbow sheen keeps reappearing above the wreck
repair_success: Repair successful. Return the vessel to the depot.
repair_wrong: This repair didn't seem to solve the issue
repair_error: Something went wrong with this repair
invalid_repair: That repair isn't one of the options.
repair_too_fast: Those are some pretty fast moves, slow down a little
patch_float: Pump out and patch the float
player_too_far_from_depot: You're too far from the depot.
vessel_too_far_from_depot: The vessel is too far from the depot to return.
job_paid: Here's your deposit and pay for a successful repair
vessel_returned: Here's your deposit back. Next time, try to fix the issue as well.
return_vessel_went_wrong: Something went wrong with returning the vessel
missing_vessel: Your vessel isn't at the depot. If you end the job now, you lose your deposit.
deposit_lost: Contract ended early without returning the vessel. I'm keeping your deposit!
vessel_lost: Vessel is lost. I'm keeping your deposit!
job_done_vessel_lost: Successful repair but vessel is lost. I'm keeping your deposit!
job_done_vessel_missing: Repair paid, but you didn't bring the vessel back. I'm keeping your deposit!
admin_ended_paid_deposit: Staff ended your contract. You received your pay and deposit (%s).
admin_ended_paid: Staff ended your contract. You received your pay (%s), but not your deposit.
admin_ended_deposit: Staff ended your contract. Your deposit (%s) has been refunded.
admin_ended: Staff ended your contract. No pay or deposit was returned.
